Theorem
[Existence of asymptotic shrinkers for Type I ancient solutions] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0186 1. ch30:30.34\group Type I Ancient Solutions

For every complete $\kappa $-noncollapsed Type I ancient Ricci flow, some backward limit is a nonflat shrinker.
